news.title: Singapore central region hits 2026 record of 181 PSI amid transboundary haze
news.summary: The central region passed the previous 2026 high of 167. NEA says south-easterly or southerly winds may keep carrying smoke to Singapore.

news.title: Haze watch: PSI enters high-unhealthy range in southern, western and central Singapore
news.summary: Schools are moving activities indoors and using air purifiers. The education ministry would consider closures only if the next day's forecast is hazardous, above PSI 300.

news.title: Singapore haze worsens as central region’s air quality nears 2026 high, smoke from Indonesia continues to drift in
news.summary: All five regions were unhealthy by 8 am, and dry weather over Sumatra and West Kalimantan may keep the fires going.

news.title: Red Skies, Thick Haze Shroud Kalimantan As Indonesia Records 1,176 Hotspots
news.summary: Visibility in Palangka Raya fell to 150 metres, and Indonesia has 61 aircraft on firefighting and patrol duty.
